notes:
{正誤|せいご} combines ⟦{正|せい}→正：09511_sei⟧ (correct) and {誤|ご} (incorrect) to mean rightness and wrongness.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{正誤表|せいごひょう}→正誤表：20961_seigohyou⟧: errata table, list of corrections
- {正誤|せいご}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: true-or-false question
- {正誤|せいご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧: to judge right from wrong

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{正誤|せいご}: whether an answer is correct

USAGE:
Primarily used in educational (tests, textbooks) and publishing (corrections, errata) contexts. In everyday conversation, ⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{間違|まちが}っている→間違う：03036_machigau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ is more natural.
